Projects.Name: Amazon.Lambda.DurableExecution.OpenTelemetry
ChangelogMessages: Initial preview of OpenTelemetry tracing for Amazon.Lambda.DurableExecution. The Invocation view emits Workflow, Invocation, operation and attempt spans through System.Diagnostics.ActivitySource, with no OpenTelemetry package dependency. ContextExtractors.W3C anchors the execution on a W3C traceparent instead of an X-Ray header.
